brief.title: Pune / Waterside location studies
brief.summary: Compare three waterside settings within 60 km of central Pune for a small photography shoot. Prefer greenery; investigate road access and facilities before deciding.

sources.title: Pune District / Khadakwasala
sources.supports: Khadakwasla is on the Mutha River and supplies Pune; Panshet and Varasgaon are nearby dams.

sources.title: Maharashtra Tourism / Panshet
sources.supports: Panshet tourism setting and general road approach; Varasgaon described with water and green hills. Tourism information does not establish filming permission.

sources.title: Maps of India / Khadakwasla location
sources.supports: Published approximate coordinates 18.442697 N, 73.763713 E. Area reference only, not an entrance. Compare against imagery and verify on site.

sources.title: Panshet / coordinate reference
sources.supports: Published approximate dam coordinates; not an access point.

sources.title: Pashan Lake / place reference
sources.supports: Pashan Lake is an artificial lake in Pune; approximate coordinates.

candidates.name: Khadakwasla / dam area
candidates.creative_fit: A water-and-infrastructure setting to assess for a grounded, recognisable Pune backdrop. This is a creative interpretation.
candidates.tradeoffs: A dam setting is not automatically secluded or open to a crew. Verify the exact accessible viewpoint.
